name: towerai
description: TowerAI — autonomous ATC simulation for Toronto Pearson (CYYZ)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/world --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
scripts.judge: npm run build && ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= TOWERAI_CONTROLLER=baseline TOWERAI_AI_PILOTS=off TOWERAI_SCENARIO=judge-demo TOWERAI_DATA_DIR=off TOWERAI_RADIO_CONTROLLER=simulated TOWERAI_RADIO_PILOTS=simulated tsx packages/server/src/index.ts
scripts.judge:live: npm run build && TOWERAI_CONTROLLER=elevenlabs TOWERAI_AI_PILOTS=on TOWERAI_CREDIT_CAP=5000 TOWERAI_SCENARIO=judge-demo TOWERAI_DATA_DIR=off TOWERAI_RADIO_CONTROLLER=simulated TOWERAI_RADIO_PILOTS=simulated node --env-file=.env --import tsx packages/server/src/index.ts
